Container.Name: SelfArchiver
Container.Overview: Self-hosted email archiver with the features other archivers lack: pick exactly which IMAP folders to archive, build rules with filters (sender / subject / attachment / age), give each rule its own schedule, and optionally delete archived mail from the source mailbox to keep it small. Everything is stored in a single container (SQLite + full-text search + .eml files on disk). No external database required.
Container.Description: Self-hosted email archiver: selective per-folder archiving, rule-based filters, per-rule schedules and archive-then-delete retention. Single container, SQLite-backed, no external services.

Config.Name: APP_SECRET
Config.Description: Stable secret for encrypting stored mailbox passwords and signing sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it constant!

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional password to protect the web UI. Leave empty for an open instance on a trusted network.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone used for per-rule cron schedules.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: trace, debug, info, warn, error.
